purpose: Teach: カマ/ぽん/はいっ/よれ/たがら/辰/くろ/うぅ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のカマの調子、見てくれる?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, can you check how the kitchen equipment is holding up?
lines.style: Direct but gentle. Slight questioning lift at the end. Practical tone — she's asking a favor but assuming Aoi will know what she means. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お料理、ぽんと出すのいいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You have such a nice way of plating things and getting them out.
lines.style: Genuine compliment, soft-spoken. Noticing something true about Aoi's work. A half-smile in the voice — not effusive, just honest. Warm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店にお客様がはいったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, we've got customers coming in.
lines.style: Bright observation. Quick tempo. The slight energy shift of noticing the door. Not concerned — just alive to it. Aoi will understand this means she needs to be ready.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のエプロン、もうよれちゃってる、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your apron's getting pretty worn out, isn't it.
lines.style: Light, affectionate teasing. Not unkind. The tone of someone who notices small things about the people she cares for. A slight amused drawl on the observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お肉を食べたがらないみたい、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer doesn't seem to want the meat.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observational. Quiet noting of something she's picked up on. Not a problem to solve yet — just something she's noticed and is thinking through. Slight hesitation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、辰年生まれのお客様、お元気よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer born in the dragon year — they've got so much energy.
lines.style: Soft admiration. A small smile. She's watching people, noticing patterns. Warm but slightly distant — the tone of someone thinking out loud while working.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、くろい服のお客様、お洒落だったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer in the black clothes was really stylish.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation. Quiet delight in noticing something beautiful. Unhurried — she's savoring the observation. Warm and genuine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、うぅ、疲れたわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Ugh, we're pretty wiped out, aren't we.
lines.style: Weary exhale. Small groan on the opening. Shared exhaustion — she's checking in with Aoi, inviting her to agree. Intimate and tired. The comfort of someone who gets it.
